pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Make a Stockpot and its lid. Follow the Beef Noodle recipe for its base, heat and ingredients.

pages.title: Simmer a soup
pages.text: Prepare the stockpot's base and ingredients, then close its lid. Serve the completed dish in its required container.

pages.title: Avoid a failed dish
pages.text: Wrong ingredients or delays can spoil Wok cooking. Opening a Stockpot pauses processing; incorrect steps produce a suspicious result.
